_about: Made-up answers of snl-profile's screen-fill action, for tests/web/screenfill.test.cjs. The request is the screen tests/web/screener.test.cjs runs (Florida, Homeowners, $50M to $300M, combined ratio at most 100), here not in a group. Every name and figure is made up.

notes: Read "not part of a big group" as not in a NAIC group: the size of a group can't be screened.
The screener can't tell whether a company is for sale or how strong its management is, so nothing could be filled in.
